tarraconian_imperial.notes: Imperial Moselle-Rhine Franconian with Old Catalan administrative generics

tarraconian_direct.summary: Already within Tarraconian Chancellery High German; apply circumflexation and Auslautverhärtung only.

high_german_to_tarraconian.summary: Map Upper/Standard German into Moselle-Rhine Franconian: preserve unshifted p-, d-, sw-/sl-/sm-; final -g/-k -> -ch; -d -> -t; -ei -> -î/-ei.

west_germanic_to_tarraconian.summary: Nativize English/Anglo-Saxon/Dutch stems to Rhine Franconian cognates: th -> d, sh -> sch, ch -> k/tsch, -burh/-by -> -burch/-stat.

north_germanic_to_tarraconian.summary: Map Old Norse/Scandinavian ð/þ -> d/t, ø -> ö, æ -> ê, -borg -> -burch, -vík -> -wîch.

gallo_romance_to_tarraconian.summary: Catalan/Franconian dual apocope: gn -> nj, j/g(e,i) -> sch, ch -> sch, final -on/-an/-o apocopated with circumflex stress.

occitano_catalan_to_tarraconian.summary: Core Catalan substrate conventions: ny -> nj, nh -> nj, j/tg -> dsch/tsch, apocope after l/r/n.

ibero_romance_to_tarraconian.summary: Iberian ñ -> nj, ll -> ll, j -> ch/sch, final -o/-a -> apocopated or -e.

italo_romance_to_tarraconian.summary: Italian -ggi-/-gi- -> dsch, -ci- -> tsch, gn -> nj, -c(k) -> k/ch, final -o/-a reduced or dropped.

eastern_romance_to_tarraconian.summary: Vlach/Romanian ș -> sch, ț -> tz, â/î -> â/î, final -a -> -e.

balkan_to_tarraconian.summary: Albanian sh -> sch, zh -> sch, ç -> tsch, xh -> dsch, q -> tj, gj -> dj, ë -> e.

celtic_to_tarraconian.summary: Celtic mh/bh -> v/w, dh/gh -> Ø/g, th -> t, final -d -> -t.

greek_to_tarraconian.summary: Byzantine Greek θ -> t, χ -> ch, φ -> f, -os/-on dropped, -ion -> -jen, -eia -> -êe, -polis -> -pel.

west_slavic_to_tarraconian.summary: West Slavic č/cz -> tsch, š/sz -> sch, ř/rz -> rsch, c -> tz, -ice/-itz -> -itz, -ov -> -ouwe.

south_slavic_to_tarraconian.summary: South Slavic č/ć -> tsch, š -> sch, ž -> sch, đ/dž -> dsch, lj -> lj, nj -> nj.

baltic_to_tarraconian.summary: Baltic š -> sch, ž -> sch, č -> tsch, finals devoiced; Old Prussian/Curonian substrates retained.

magyar_to_tarraconian.summary: Hungarian sz -> s, s -> sch, cs -> tsch, zs -> sch, gy -> dj, ly -> l/j, vár -> wâr.

uralic_to_tarraconian.summary: Finnic/Permian ä/ö/ü retained or lowered; long vowels circumflexed; -la/-lä -> -le; -k -> -ch.

caucasian_to_tarraconian.summary: Caucasian ejectives/aspirates mapped cleanly: kh/x -> ch, gh -> g, j -> dsch, ch/č -> tsch, sh -> sch.

arabic_to_tarraconian.summary: Arabic ج -> dsch, ش -> sch, خ/ق -> ch, ع/ء dropped, long ā/ī/ū -> â/î/û, final -b/-d/-g/-j -> -p/-t/-ch/-tsch.

semitic_to_tarraconian.summary: Syriac/Hebrew sh -> sch, kh -> ch, ts -> z-/tz, y -> j.

iranian_to_tarraconian.summary: Persian/Sogdian sh -> sch, zh -> sch, kh -> ch, j -> dsch, ch -> tsch, final -b/-d/-g devoiced.

turkic_to_tarraconian.summary: Turkic ş -> sch, ç -> tsch, c -> dsch, q/kh -> ch, ö/ü preserved, post-vocalic -k -> -ch, j -> dsch.

mongolic_to_tarraconian.summary: Mongolic sh -> sch, ch -> tsch, j -> dsch, kh -> ch, ö/ü retained, final -a -> -e.

sinosphere_1154_to_tarraconian.summary: Sinosphere 1154 historical phonology: j/zh -> dsch, q/ch -> tsch, x/sh -> sch, z/c -> z-/-tz, initial y -> j.

east_asian_to_tarraconian.summary: Nivkh/Ainu stops & sibilants: ch -> tsch, sh -> sch, j -> dsch, final -a -> -e.

indic_to_tarraconian.summary: Indic j -> dsch, c/ch -> tsch, sh/ṣ -> sch, y -> j, long ā/ī/ū -> â/î/û, unaccented final -a -> -e.

tibetic_to_tarraconian.summary: Tibetan palatal & affricate mapping: ts/tsh -> z-/tz, dz -> ds, zh/sh -> sch, ny -> nj, j -> dsch.

southeast_asian_to_tarraconian.summary: Mainland/Insular SEA sh -> sch, ch -> tsch, j -> dsch, ny -> nj, ng -> ng.

african_to_tarraconian.summary: African affricates dj/j -> dsch, sh -> sch, ch -> tsch, ny -> nj, y -> j.

historical_intermediaries.summary: Anatolian Greek stems reanalyzed in Oghuz Turkish before Tarraconian contact (-polis -> -bolu, k- -> g-, vowel harmony)
Balkan Greek/Thracian substrates adapted into Bulgarian/Serbian (liquid metathesis, o/a shifts, -os dropped)
Levantine/Egyptian Greek adapted to Arabic phonology (p -> b/f, ch -> kh, g -> j/gh, -eia -> -iya)
Andalusi Arabic wadi -> guad-, al- preserved as prefix, kh -> j/g
Persian urban generics (-abad, -shahr, -bazar) transmitted across Khorasan/Transoxiana Turkic dynasties
Pannonian/Carpathian Slavic stems absorbed with Magyar cluster simplification & initial vowel epenthesis
Romano-Brythonic stems compounded with Old English generics (-ceaster, -tun, -ford)
Classical Chinese Hanzi compounds read via Sino-Korean (EMK), Sino-Japanese Go-on/Kan-on (EMJ), or Sino-Vietnamese per 1154 concordance
